notes.title: New Patch 1.3 is up!
notes.content:
Patch 1.3 has the following updates:
- Added Xbox Controller Support
- Added Oculus Headset and Controller Support
- Added Interior Baeliog Experience to Quarpedia
- Improvement to limiting teleportable positions
- Selecting Lorn Hill now takes you directly to the scene
- Always reset view when loading new level
- Added audio to notify player of new Lorn Letter
- Improved UI visuals (Arrow for selection works better)
- Save files now store volume settings and floor height
- Fixed glitch where player could load a mission further than they had unlocked
- Added audio to SplashScreen
- Balanced some audio
- Prevented player from shrinking while upgrading a base building as that broke the chalkboard
- Fixed Quarpedia stats sometimes not displaying correct values
- Fixed text saying "Table Height" when it should be "Floor Height"

notes.title: New Patch 1.2 is up!
notes.content:
Patch 1.2 has the following updates:
•	Added Steam achievements.
•	Added the ability to raise the floor.
•	Added a directional turn control when teleporting.
•	Added teleportation to the Mechanic’s Bay.
•	Fixed a bug that would not play the Lorn Hill Letter that was selected.

notes.title: New Patch 1.1 is up!
notes.content:
Patch 1.1 has a the following updates:

- End Turns on certain units should no longer lock up.
- Added Quality settings to game load screen.
- Fixed chalkboard issue in "Letters home" section.
- Cosmetic tweaks - added airships, lighting tweaks.

If you encounter any issue please send an email to support@steelwoolgames.com

notes.title: Upcoming Patch Early Next Week
notes.content:
We will be patching Quar: Battle for Gate 18 very soon!

Patch Updates:

- Further Optimization Pass

- Quality Settings dialog box during Game Launch

- Fixed an error when a unit would occasionally get stuck. NOTE: You can usually bypass this error currently by pressing the menu button, dropping to the Steam window, then pressing the menu button to return to game.

- Cosmetic updates and tweaks
